notes:
Console 2.3.44. The INITIALS column now prints a sign-off per subject.
- Every subject carries its own initials, edited on the Subjects screen, so a card prints MD, MF, AKD and the rest even when no teacher record is assigned to that subject
- When a subject has no initials of its own, the assigned teacher's initials are used exactly as before
- New schools start with the standard O-Level subject set already signed: Mathematics MD, English MF, Physics LD, Chemistry CA, Biology CA, History GD, Geography KL, Agriculture KL, Entrepreneurship AKD, ICT SJ, Art and Design KJ, Runyoro Rutooro MF, Kiswahili A, CRE AK, Physical Education K
